>
[Sequestered Spell](/Feats.aspx?ID=5384) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Surki" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=789" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 50

</column>

---

You consumed so much of a type of magic as a larva that you can now cast it purely on instinct. Choose one [cantrip](/Traits.aspx?ID=550) from the spell list of your magiphage ability. You can cast this cantrip as an innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
name: Sequestered Spell
